name: multi-agent-watch
description: Detect when multiple Claude Code sessions work the same repo concurrently, and help them coordinate: per-session self-summaries generated on read by /mw-status (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash via OpenRouter, 15-minute cache), each sibling's native Claude Code name in every roster for SendMessage, and subscriptions. Collisions surfaced via terminal banner, desktop notification, and context injection.
